name: apikey-quota-scripts
title: Custom API-key quota scripts
description: Add per-account custom quota scripts and native reset time tooltips with countdowns for default and custom quota queries. Use cc-switch only as an interaction reference.
creator: sub2api-plugins
notes: The user approved implementation. Use cc-switch only as an interaction reference. Store one quota_script string. Both forms test current code and draft settings without saving. Show custom errors and keep default detection silent. Reuse native quota bars, units, countdowns, and reset tooltips. Weekly subscription reset uses the reported start plus seven days, with an explanatory code comment. Save the earlier available key/subscription expiry to native account expiration. Do not use expiry as a monthly reset. Preserve missing dates and unrelated settings. Both executables target 0.2.19. The complete review found and fixed masked-key cache invalidation. Final default build 82928 passed. Follow focused tests without duplicate matrices or additional acceptance gates. GitHub credential use, ordinary commits, and remote publication retain separate approval.

meta.current_scope: Earlier available key/subscription expiry persists to native Account.ExpiresAt through narrow BulkUpdate. Monthly reset mapping is absent. Direct weekly addition remains. Complete backend and frontend review found one cache defect, now fixed. Final default build 82928 passed.
meta.reset_date_addition: AC2 and AC6 passed. Native account expiration appears after the next account-list refresh. Preserve v0.2.19, scripts, native tooltips, and the upstream API rollback.
